trustBoundary.heading: The generated result stays temporary
trustBoundary.body: Eligible vehicle or property facts may recover automatically only on this browser for 30 days. A deliberate successful secure save stores supported facts for verified-email return across sessions or devices. The generated result itself remains temporary and is not saved, and no case is opened.

choose.heading: Start with the issue you need to solve.
choose.body: This public intake stays on the claims already in launch scope. Pick the lane that matches your situation first.

details.heading: Answer the guided intake.
details.body: We only need the core facts for the first pack shell: what happened, when it happened, who is involved, and what you want to recover.
details.counterpartyPlaceholder: Insurer, landlord, employer, hospital, driver, or other party
details.desiredOutcome: What do you want to recover?
details.summaryPlaceholder: Add the core facts you would want repeated consistently in a complaint, notice, or follow-up call.

preview.heading: Review your Free Start pack shell.
preview.body: This shell keeps the intake facts together before deeper guidance, evidence prompts, or staff escalation.

includes.summary: A structured intake summary you can reuse without rewriting the facts.
includes.timeline: A clean timeline anchor with the date, issue type, and responsible party.
includes.handoff: A consistent handoff point for membership, hotline follow-up, or later escalation.

completion.heading: Your intake is complete.
completion.body: Your temporary summary is ready. It has not been saved and no case has been opened.

high.label: High
high.body: Your intake shows a clear recovery path with a defined counterparty and a concrete outcome.

medium.label: Medium
medium.body: Your intake is usable, but the facts suggest document review before you escalate.

low.label: Low
low.body: Your intake looks closer to guidance-only follow-up or early routing support than a clear recovery path.

levels.high: Join Asistenca for a team review within 24 business hours.
levels.medium: Upgrade for document review before you send the first complaint or notice.
levels.low: Use the hotline for routing support and the clearest next step before you escalate.

membership.high: Join Asistenca for a team review

member.high: Continue in member claims for review
member.medium: Continue in member claims and request review

portal.high: Continue in the portal for review
portal.medium: Continue in the portal and request review

hotline.low: Call the hotline for next-step guidance

support.heading: Keep the first step clean and consistent.
support.body: The shell is designed to keep your first public intake short, repeatable, and ready for the next trust surfaces without reopening the facts.

points.lane: You choose the right commercial lane first: vehicle, property, or injury.
points.facts: The intake captures only the core facts needed to move forward clearly.
points.handoff: The same facts can flow into membership or follow-up without a routing change.

placeholder.heading: Choose a claim type to see the strongest evidence for the first pack.
placeholder.body: Free Start stays lightweight, but the right photos, reports, and cost proof make the later review faster.

vehicle.heading: Vehicle claims move faster with scene, insurer, and repair proof.
vehicle.body: Gather the basics before you ask for review so the pack can show what happened, who is involved, and what the loss looks like.

items.first: Photos of the vehicle damage and the wider scene.
items.second: Police note, insurer claim number, or incident report if one exists.
items.third: Repair estimate, tow invoice, or payout message that shows the amount in dispute.

property.heading: Property claims need damage records, ownership context, and repair costs.
property.body: Capture the condition before cleanup and keep the papers that show who is responsible for the building or policy.

items.first: Photos or video of every damaged room before cleanup.
items.second: Lease, ownership, insurer, or building-manager details tied to the damaged address.
items.third: Repair estimate, contractor note, or receipts for urgent mitigation costs.

injury.heading: Injury claims need treatment records, incident facts, and loss evidence.
injury.body: Keep the medical timeline and the incident facts aligned so later review can see both the harm and the recovery path.

items.first: Medical notes, discharge papers, or treatment summaries.
items.second: Incident report, witness details, or photos that show how the injury happened.
items.third: Receipts, wage-loss proof, or other documents that show the financial impact.

privacy.heading: Gather first, share later.
privacy.body: You do not need to upload documents in Free Start. Start with the minimum facts, and share evidence later only if you want a team review through membership or hotline follow-up.

triage.heading: Membership starts the review clock.
triage.body: Asistenca members receive a response from the team within 24 business hours after a complete claim pack arrives. If something is missing, we ask for it within the same window. Free Start stays informational, and the hotline stays routing-only.

validation.chooseCategory: Choose vehicle, property, or injury before continuing.
